title: Agents choosing what to publish on the Lean tree, matched to the Lean runs, by α

design.question: Set up like the Lean runs, does flow-back make agents choose to share?
design.compare: α 1, 0.8 and 0.2, agents choosing what to publish
design.fixed: the Lean tree, 4 identical agents, equal money
design.measure: share of ideas published at once

caveats: A simulation with guessed parameters: it shows how the rules play out, not that they work.
